title: channels__collect — input
$comment: x-status: planned — quorum semantics unresolved; open questions: (1) Quorum semantics: does 'count' mean count-of-ACKs-with-status=done, count-of-any-reply messages, or configurable via status_filter? Current lean: configurable via status_filter, defaulting to any reply. (2) Cancel verb: can a caller cancel an in-progress collect mid-wait? No cancel verb is defined in v1; timeout is the only termination path. (3) Multiple-collector semantics: can two agents call channels__collect with the same reply_to simultaneously? Likely yes — each collector holds an independent wait; needs conformance test.
description: Input schema for the SOX channels__collect operation. Server-side fan-in aggregation: blocks until 'count' replies to a broadcast arrive, or until 'timeout' seconds elapse. Uses the pending-state record maintained by channels__ack — no new backing-store primitive required. PLANNED: quorum semantics, cancel verb, and multiple-collector behaviour are open questions (see $comment). For efficient HTTP implementations, the transport SHOULD use long-poll or SSE; the stdio binding satisfies collect via asyncio blocking with no extra transport. Normative reference: docs/decisions/fanout-collect.md.

reply_to.description: The message_id of the broadcast message whose replies are being collected. The server monitors channels__ack calls referencing this message_id.

count.description: The number of qualifying replies to wait for before returning successfully. The server returns as soon as this count is reached, even if timeout has not elapsed.

timeout.description: Maximum number of seconds to wait for replies. When elapsed, the server returns whatever has been collected so far with timed_out=true. Maximum server-enforced cap: 300 seconds.

status_filter.description: Optional filter on ACK status values that count toward the 'count' threshold. When null or omitted, any ACK (any status) counts. Example: ['done'] waits for 'count' agents to ACK with status=done before returning.
